discussion: I now have all source files. The bug is clear: windows.py DayWindow.contains() requires the entire shift to fit inside [midnight, next midnight). An overnight shift (e.g. 22:00–06:00) spans two calendar days, so it is never 'contained' in either day's window and is dropped from both reports. The fix: replace contains() with an overlap_minutes() that computes the intersection of the shift interval and the window interval, then add only those overlapping minutes in report_minutes().
